name: @domily/next
description: PageSpec protocol, registry, source-codec contracts, and native DOM host for Domily Next

scripts.build: rm -rf ./lib && bun build ./src/index.ts ./src/business-form.ts ./src/codec.ts ./src/delivery.ts ./src/dom.ts ./src/extensions.ts ./src/native-html.ts ./src/pagespec.ts ./src/registry.ts --bundle --root ./src --outdir ./lib --target browser --format esm && tsc -b ./tsconfig.types.json --force && pnpm run verify:package
scripts.verify:package: node --input-type=module -e "await Promise.all([import('@domily/next'), import('@domily/next/business-form'), import('@domily/next/codec'), import('@domily/next/delivery'), import('@domily/next/dom'), import('@domily/next/extensions'), import('@domily/next/native-html'), import('@domily/next/pagespec'), import('@domily/next/registry')]);"
